enabled.name: Weapon readiness
enabled.hint: Track whether each weapon from equipment is ready, holstered, slung, stowed or dropped (icon on each weapon row; /ready and /holster). In combat, attacking with an unready weapon takes a Ready maneuver or a Fast-Draw roll, reloading needs the gun in hand (Fast-Draw (Ammo) takes a second off), and only ready weapons can parry. Out of combat, attacking simply draws the weapon.

combatStart.name: Weapons when combat starts
combatStart.hint: Keep each weapon as it is, or put every combatant's weapons back in their carry state (pistols and knives holstered, long arms slung) when the GM starts combat.

readiness.off: Weapon readiness is turned off in the Agency settings.

tooltip.noFastDraw: No Fast-Draw: takes a Ready maneuver
tooltip.hint: Click: next state. Right-click: carry state and Fast-Draw.

prompt.title: {weapon} is not ready
prompt.introAttack: {weapon} is {state}: it has to be readied before you can attack with it.
prompt.readyText: Takes this turn (Ready maneuver); attack next turn.
prompt.readyOffTurn: Marks it ready; it is not this character's turn, so the maneuver is left alone.
prompt.successAttack: Success: ready at once, and the attack goes ahead.
prompt.failureText: Failure: ready, but the turn is spent. Critical failure: dropped.
prompt.noSpecialty: No Fast-Draw specialty covers this weapon.
prompt.notFrom: Can't Fast-Draw a weapon that is {state}.
prompt.noSkill: No Fast-Draw ({specialty}) skill (it has no default).
prompt.modifierHint: Situation only, e.g. a concealed holster. The modifiers already in the bucket are kept for the attack.

fastDraw.failure: Fast-Draw ({specialty}) failed: {weapon} is ready, but the turn is spent (Ready maneuver).
fastDraw.critical-failure: Fast-Draw ({specialty}) critical failure: {weapon} is dropped, and the turn is spent.

ammo.critical-failure: {skill}: critical failure, the magazine is dropped. No reload.

config.title: Readiness: {weapon}
config.carryHint: How it is carried when not in hand: where /holster puts it, and where it goes when combat starts (if the GM chose that).
config.fastDrawHint: The Fast-Draw specialty that readies it. Guns: Pistol or Long Arm from the gun class.
